title: Case Study

fields.label: Client name
fields.name: client_name
fields.instructions: Must be on PROJECT.md §6's client list, or anonymized. No other client names.

fields.label: Editorial status
fields.name: editorial_status
fields.instructions: Added 2026-08-05 ("10/10" pass, see NOTES.md) — a real content-governance signal for the team, separate from the WP post_status (which only controls whether visitors can see this at all). Doesn't block anything by itself: publishing this post while this still says "Draft" is not prevented in code, since a hard block risks locking out a legitimate publish this session couldn't fully test. Set to "Published" as the team's own confirmation that Pull quote / Metrics / client approval are genuinely in place, not placeholders.

fields.label: Metrics
fields.name: metrics
fields.instructions: Real sourced figures only. Tag any unsourced figure TODO(metric) in the Value field's admin note rather than publishing an invented number (PROJECT.md §6/CLAUDE.md).

fields.label: Pull quote
fields.name: pull_quote
fields.instructions: Leave blank unless a real quote exists. Do not invent a testimonial attributed to a real person.

fields.label: Hero image
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: TEMPORARY STOCK PHOTOS may be in use here (site-wide stock sourcing pass, see NOTES.md). Check the attachment's caption/description in Media Library for source + license before reuse. Replace with real client photography before launch.

fields.label: Hero video
fields.name: hero_video
fields.instructions: Optional. Takes priority over Hero image above if both are set — muted, autoplay, loops. Never plays for a visitor with "reduce motion" turned on (Hero image shows instead, including as this video's poster). Keep the file small — a compressed .mp4, a few seconds looping cleanly, no audio track needed since it's always muted.

fields.label: Hero image is stock/representative (not the real client site)
fields.name: hero_image_is_stock
fields.instructions: TEMPORARY: check this while hero_image is a generic stock photo standing in for real client photography. When checked, the case study page shows a visible "Representative image" disclaimer over the photo. Uncheck once hero_image is replaced with a real photo of this client.

description: PROJECT.md §4 CPT `case_study`. Confirmed real case-study clients (§6): Drakes Supermarkets, Brisbane City Council, Macquarie Bank — no others without new client approval.
